state.task: Render a complete original 24 by 24 pixel-art image. Choose the final color of every requested pixel. All pixels belong to the same coherent image.
state.image: A simple recognizable white human skull icon on a black background. Front view. A rounded cranium, two large hollow black eye sockets, a small black triangular nasal hole, white cheekbones, and a narrow jaw with separated teeth. Centered, symmetric, generous black margin. Flat two-color pixel art. No text or other objects.

canvas.coordinates: Integer coordinates, origin top-left. x=0 left, x=23 right, y=0 top, y=23 bottom. Square pixels.
